table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= item.name,  
			itempacking = itempacking.name, 
			accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
			salesman = dbo.users.username, 
			srinvcode = dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
			saleinvcode = dbo.srledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleheaderinvno = dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,    
         date = dbo.srledger.date,   
         invdiscperc = dbo.srledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.srledger.salestax,   
         remarks = dbo.srledger.remarks,   
         dbo.srledger.custcode, 
         gcode = srdetail.gcode,   
         icode = srdetail.icode,   
         batch = srdetail.batch,   
         expiry = srdetail.expiry,   
			looseqty = srdetail.looseqty,
			bonusqty = srdetail.bonusqty,
			packqty  = srdetail.packqty,
			packunits= srdetail.packunits,
	 		saleprice= srdetail.srprice,
	 		discperc = srdetail.discperc,
         salestax = srdetail.salestax,
 			ref = 0

    FROM srledger, 
			srdetail, 
			saleledger,
			accounts, 
			customer,
			users, 
			item  
			LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode)
 
   WHERE ( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = :ar_SRInvCode ) AND
			( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode) AND
			( dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.srledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
			( dbo.srdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode) AND
			( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.srledger.saleinvcode)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) , 2)
